Pins MISSING_TECHNICAL_READ, which no case in either tier covered.

Four FACS-sorted motor-neuron libraries from two reporter strains where strain is the ONLY attribute that differs between samples — so it is the case whose per-accession claim carries the whole anti-shuffle burden. Also the corpus's clearest archive-vs-paper genotype drift (kasIs2 written two ways).

The sex axis carried entirely by a proxy: the archive declares no sex attribute at all, so hermaphrodite-vs-male survives only as the Him5 marker inside genotype. Pins that a free-text genotype still discriminates after the verbose tissue strings were pruned.

The only real ORIGINAL fixed-offset BD Rhapsody bead. Half of a deliberate pair with GSE282765-colon-crod-wta: both extract protocols name the same instrument ("BD Rhapsody Express Single-Cell Analysis System") and differ only in the declared bead, so deciding BD chemistry from anything but the R1 bytes gets exactly one of the two wrong.

The only real BD Rhapsody ENHANCED library. It closes the -v2 leaf only; enhanced-v1 (97x3), 10x-5p-gex-v2/v3 and 10x-gemx-3p-v4 are still synthetic-only. Before it, the 0-3bp diversity insert, the GTGA/GACA linkers and the anchored frame recovery had been proven only on reads seqforge generated from its own spec. On real reads the frame phase-locks in 92.6% and the 384x3 pools hit 0.93-0.97 against 0.001 for the disjoint 97x3 pools.
The only bulk paired-end arm — the non-single-cell branch of the modality-general architecture, and the negative control that keeps a barcode-free library from being read as a chemistry.

The only case reaching a non-STARsolo pipeline (map/chromap) from bytes, and the real-data guard on the ATAC barcode geometry: a 24bp barcode read = 8bp lead-in + 16bp CB at offset 8, reverse-complement, matching a DISJOINT ARC-ATAC whitelist. A regression that reverts the geometry fix drops it to bulk-rnaseq-pe.
An over-sequenced 28bp CB+UMI R1 that is told apart from plain 3' v3 ONLY by the ARC whitelist — the corpus's test that a whitelist, not a read geometry, can be the deciding evidence.

The pilot's worked example, and the only accession present in BOTH tiers (evals/cases/real from real FASTQs behind an env var, and here byte-light) — so the two paths must reach the same verdict. The dataset whose single-nucleus label priced the 40.7% gene-only counting defect (ADR-0012).

The only dataset where sex VARIES across samples (3 hermaphrodite + 5 male off one him-8 strain), so it is the one case pinning a per-sample attribute that actually discriminates. Its per-accession claim sits on the minority class, catching a shuffled join 5 times in 8 rather than 3.

Two samples that must never be merged or tidied into each other: QX2314xPTM299_F4 is the F4 eQTL mapping pool, QX2314+PTM299 is the pooled-parents control. The submitter's x-versus-plus notation is load-bearing, and the case exists to stop a future reader "fixing" the spelling.

The only real bd-rhapsody-wta-enhanced-v1 (97x3) library, closing the last synthetic-only BD leaf and making the BD arm a triple: GSE274290 is the original fixed-offset bead, GSE282765-colon-crod-wta is Enhanced on 384x3, this is Enhanced on the disjoint 97x3. Unlike its -v2 sibling this leaf SHARES its whitelists with the original bead, so the onlist cannot carry it and only the staggered GTGA/GACA linker frame separates the two -- the corpus one real-read test of per-read anchored frame recovery against a live alternative.
